name: Silesian Confederacy
source: HH0, HH1, HH6, HH11, HH12, Companion, Jayne's Intelligence Review v1

lore.summary: A multi-system confederation of planetary governments of around sixty inhabited systems in nine sectors, bordered by the Andermani Empire and the Sidemore Republic to the galactic south-west and the Basilisk System to the north-east. Founded as an enlightened confederation, by the turn of the 20th century PD it was a byword for corrupt governments, mercenaries, piracy and insurrection, and the proving ground where the Andermani and Manticoran navies sent new officers on anti-piracy patrol. In 1921 PD it was annexed by the Andermani Empire and the Star Kingdom of Manticore; the central government handed its powers to them while the system governments were retained.
lore.executive: Cabinet, sector governors, system governors (about 75% of system governors elected, the rest appointed)
lore.extent: roughly 105 ly across, about 600,000 cubic light-years

partition.notes: Partitioned between two nations, which a single `succeeded_by` cannot express, so it stays null.

territory.note: No Silesian system is built yet. `silesia` here is the Silesia System (the capital system per HH0 and Jayne's Intelligence Review v1); the compiler stubs it until a system file exists, as it does other referenced-but-unbuilt systems. The Manticoran half of the partition is already recorded in star-kingdom-of-manticore.json (protectorates).
